response.overview: Amore Amaro" is a documentary that closely examines the life and work of Letizia Battaglia, one of the most important photographers in Italian history. Through her candid account, the film takes the viewer on a journey of images, memories, and experiences that profoundly shaped her way of seeing the world. Palermo is the constant backdrop to this story: a complex, beloved, and painful city, which Battaglia has photographed for decades without filters or compromise. Her images speak of current events, of violence, but also of ordinary people—women, children, and an often invisible everyday life. The documentary shows how photography, for Letizia Battaglia, was never just a profession, but a lifestyle choice. "Amore Amaro" invites us to reflect on the power of images and the role of the photographer as an active witness to reality.
response.title: Amore Amaro
